summary: Queue discipline, wizard folder picker fix, GTK crash fix and deletion-review grouping.
changelog: A folder no longer re-runs immediately from its own engine-generated file events: the journal nextcloudcmd writes inside the synced folder no longer triggers a requeue (issue #181).
The account setup wizard loads the remote folder list from the stored credentials instead of a cleared password field (issue #147).
Conflict/Recent/Deletion lists are emptied with remove_all() instead of unparent(), fixing an intermittent GTK crash during sync (issue #153).
The mass-deletion review groups paths by top-level folder with expanders, so a large cleanup is readable at a glance (issue #182).
The flaky login-flow integration test is stable: requests are answered by URL, verified 60/60 runs (issue #174).
The heavy-folder re-discovery issue is closed as superseded: the ETag gate (#189) + queue discipline (#181) stop the no-change re-scan (issue #166).
